info.description: The routes hello serves. Every path is relative to the mount the host assigns, and the host serves this document rebased under it at <mount>/openapi.json.

get.description: What the module holds, and the principal the host authorized, which is the host's answer and never a header the caller set. The host takes view_resource on the module's instance before this is called.
